engine: Chromium (Playwright); WebKit: unavailable in QA environment
safari_handling: History writes wrapped in try/catch (Safari rate-limits pushState/replaceState); page-load fallback if history is unavailable
Search redraws only the list, so the focused input and the iOS keyboard are not replaced while typing
Inputs are 16px on touch devices to prevent iOS focus zoom
List scrolling uses scrollTop on the record column, never scrollIntoView, so the fixed page cannot shift
Back/forward cache restores are handled (pageshow); the eagle never replays on Back/Forward
100dvh with 100% fallback; safe-area insets on all edges of interior pages and Fieldwork
Palette carried in history.state and sessionStorage (works with storage blocked)
outstanding: Physical iPhone Safari pass (swipe-back gesture, URL-bar resize) before publishing
